messages.text: Do you sell slippers that are actual slippers rather than slides? I need slippers that have a back to stay on and keep both whole feet warm.

Hello Alisa,

Sorry for the longer than usual response time.

Thank you for reaching out with your inquiry. Unfortunately, we currently do not have slippers with a full back in our product range. We appreciate your interest in our products and hope you find the perfect slippers that meet your needs elsewhere.

Hope you consider adding a full-back design! Then my daughter could wear them too. She is vegan (so would never wear goose down) and also wears orthotics so she can’t have “slides” or “mules” anymore.
